acts.palette: charcoal black, archive cream, tarnished brass, slate gray, muted teal, dusty blue
acts.map: Tall vertical cut-paper diorama of an imagined recording archive viewed from above, the journey reading bottom to top. Start at a dusty blue entry table with a black disc and cracked horn, pass shelves of blank sleeves, a copper repair bench and a small acoustic theater, then climb between rows of turntables and disc presses. Leave a broad, quiet cream middle ground for readable path lines. At the top, a distinct circular press chamber holds the waiting Capture Engine. Teal hexagonal paper growth creeps up from the machines toward the chamber. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colors, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and directional shadow-theater light; no readable text or logos.
backdrops: Wide fight background for floors 1–5: a quiet archive aisle of cream shelves, slate acoustic panels, black discs and a distant brass horn, with an icy blue worktable at one edge. A few muted teal hexagonal cutouts appear around floor seams. Low contrast, subdued flat colors and an open, uncluttered center for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, crisp cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theater lighting; no readable text or logos.

Wide fight background for floors 6–10: the same archive deeper inside, with gray baffles, disc racks and a dark press silhouette along the edges. Muted teal hexagonal growth now joins into patches across shelves and floor seams, partly covering equipment. Keep the center open and low contrast for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colors, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theater light; no readable text or logos.

Wide fight background for floors 11–15: the archive press room, its distant racks, horn shapes and platen nearly swallowed by broad overlapping muted teal hexagonal sheets. A few black discs and brass fittings remain visible at the edges; preserve a quiet, low-contrast central floor for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colors, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theater light; no readable text or logos.
acts.boss: Full-body Capture Engine, large and imposing in a centered portrait composition: a tall black turntable mounted on a heavy wheeled cabinet, a flared tarnished-brass horn rising to one side, a toothed press on the other and a ring of small disc feeders around its body. Show the complete wheels and horn, with a powerful asymmetrical silhouette and teal hexagonal growth gripping the base. Cut from layered, visibly grainy construction paper in flat colors, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at moving joints, with deep directional shadow-theater light. No readable text or logos.

acts.palette: dark walnut, antique brass, wax cream, blue gray, muted teal, amber
acts.map: Tall vertical cut-paper diorama of an imagined instrument museum seen from above, journey rising from bottom to top. Begin in a tiled entry hall with a brass bell, wind past wooden instrument cases, wax cylinders and open galleries of pipes and horns, then approach a mechanical orchestra. Keep the middle ground broad and open in wax cream so path lines stay readable. At the top, a clearly defined orchestra gallery houses the waiting Orchestrion Keeper. Muted teal hexagonal growth spreads across the gallery edges and instrument clamps. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colors, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and shadow-theater light; no readable text or logos.
backdrops: Wide fight background for floors 1–5: a calm instrument gallery with blue-gray tiled floor, dark walnut cases, cream cylinders and a few distant brass horns along the walls. Sparse muted teal hexagons gather around case feet. Use low contrast, subdued colors and a clear central playing area for small creatures. Grainy layered construction paper, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theater light; no readable text or logos.

Wide fight background for floors 6–10: deeper museum galleries with ranks of muted brass pipes, folded panels and instrument cases at the sides. Clusters of teal hexagonal paper growth spread up the cabinets and around the clamps holding instruments. Keep the center open and low contrast for small creatures. Grainy layered construction paper, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theater light; no readable text or logos.

Wide fight background for floors 11–15: the orchestra gallery, with pipe ranks, bellows and wooden cases largely enclosed by overlapping muted teal hexagonal growth and clamp shapes. Leave only fragments of walnut and brass visible around the edges, and a quiet low-contrast central floor for small creatures. Grainy layered construction paper, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theater light; no readable text or logos.
acts.boss: Full-body Orchestrion Keeper, towering in a centered composition with a broad, unmistakable silhouette: a dark walnut cabinet crowned by rows of antique-brass pipes, broad hinged side panels spread like wings, an expanding bellows belly and hooked metal feet planted apart. Suggest captured instruments held in side clamps without obscuring the body. Muted teal hexagonal growth grips the cabinet's lower corners. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colors, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and dramatic shadow-theater light; no readable text or logos.

acts.palette: deep leaf green, nursery cream, pond blue, tarnished brass, muted teal, moon yellow
acts.map: Tall vertical cut-paper diorama of imagined gardens and a living nursery seen from above, journey rising from bottom to top. Begin among garden beds and a branching tree, pass specimen crates, a blue water tank with separate pipes and glass coral bowls, then enter a greenhouse nursery. Leave a broad cream and pale blue middle ground open for readable path lines. At the top, a distinct round nursery chamber contains the waiting Nature Keeper beneath its yellow moon lamp. Teal hexagonal growth spreads along pipes and into the nursery. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colors, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and shadow-theater light; no readable text or logos.
backdrops: Wide fight background for floors 1–5: garden beds, a dark green scaled tree and cream specimen crates at the edges, with a distant pond-blue tank and a few teal hexagons around pipe joints. Low contrast and subdued colors, with an open central floor for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theater light; no readable text or logos.

Wide fight background for floors 6–10: a greenhouse nursery with pale glass bowls, muted coral shapes, separate blue pipes and leafy beds along the sides. Muted teal hexagonal patches spread over crates, pipes and greenhouse frames, visibly restricting water and growth. Keep the center open and low contrast for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theater light; no readable text or logos.

Wide fight background for floors 11–15: the inner nursery, its glass tanks, seed drawers, pipes and yellow lamp dimly visible behind broad interlocking sheets of muted teal hexagonal growth. Plants and water channels are almost enclosed; retain a quiet, low-contrast open center for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theater light; no readable text or logos.
acts.boss: Full-body Nature Keeper, a towering green and brass nursery machine with a strong branching silhouette, centered and completely visible. A round moon-yellow lamp crowns its body, a pond-blue tank forms its belly, long hose arms branch outward, and a ring of hinged seed drawers surrounds its lower frame. Teal hexagonal growth binds parts of the hoses and base; small coral shapes show inside the tank. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colors, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and dramatic shadow-theater light; no readable text or logos.
